t: This is Archway Bridge, a bridge in London that carries traffic over the road below. It was designed by Alexander Binnie, a British civil engineer who lived from 1839 to 1917. Binnie was responsible for several major engineering projects, including a number connected with crossings of the River Thames in London. So this bridge belongs to a career built around getting people and traffic across water and over obstacles. Take a look at the structure itself and how it spans the gap.
